verdict.tagline: A legendary open-world sandbox hidden behind a wall of technical hurdles.
for_you_if: you already know how to wrestle with legacy launchers
you can overlook broken achievements and save quirks
you want a sprawling tropical sandbox
not_for_you_if: you will not install a third-party launcher
you need stable performance on modern hardware
you want multiple save slots without hassle

distortion_flags.sentence: Positive review proportions increase the longer players spend with the game.
Recent reviews reflect lower satisfaction scores compared to historical averages.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early players run into severe crashes and mandatory third-party launcher requirements that stop them from playing.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the game fails to launch or crashes on modern PC hardware and multi-core CPUs.

citations.review_text:
Not Good on Modern Hardware.

It seems as though if your CPU has more than 4 Cores and you have more than 2GB of RAM, you will very likely experience constant crashes. There are supposed fixes online, but nothing simple works. Shame, because the story does start out to be very interesting. The same thing happens on games like Prototype.

Apparently, this game doesn't run on newer multy-core PCs . There seems to be a workaround with deactivating some of the cores but I gave up after trying a bit, I really don't want to fiddle around so long with system configurations before I can even start up a game. Ubisoft, stop selling this game if you're not providing patches for newer PCs, else it's just a scam.

Be warned, if you are running Windows 11, you likely to have issues getting this game to run.  Truly, Ubisoft is the epitome of incompetency.  I'm requesting a refund.  Getting it to run is too big of a hassle.  You have to change your bootup settings so your CPU is only using 4 cores.  There are games built by 1 person that are more stable and run out of the box.  Ubisoft has thousands of employees yet sets the standard for incompetency.

Loved the game back in the day. Unfortunately got this on a discount and even though I managed to start the game(had to disable CPU cores for that to happen), then the sound stopped working and a black screen after the opening segment ended it for me. 

Final verdict: This game is not compatible with modern CPUs, showcasing again the sad reality of a company like Ubisoft.

Ubi support was no help.

Objectively good game, but posting a negative review to voice my displeasure with Ubisoft and their ♥♥♥♥♥♥ support, who somehow can't unlink my steam key from the deleted ubi account

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game experiences random crashes on modern hardware and requires community fixes or workarounds to run stably.

citations.review_text: MAKE NO MISTAKE, I LOVE THIS GAME. However, due to the passage of time, I cannot recommend it in the current year of 2026, UNLESS you have an older PC you can play it on that will play nice with the software. I beat this game on PS3 back in the day, got it on PC a few years later in like 2015 when I got a gaming laptop. 8GB of DDR3 and a GTA 960m. It ran great on that. However, even when trying to use community fixes, using process lasso to limit the cores for better FPS, and running on the "more stable" DX9, it crashes on my current rig after less than 5 minutes. Some other games from the same era don't have this problem, but anything on Dunia is absolutely horrid. I really do not like rereleases of games, but this needs a remaster to be reliably played. Too bad Ubisoft has been too busy ruining themselves as a company and destroying any credibility as a publisher and a developer for nearly a decade.
The game itself is great, but the amount of research for fixing performance and prevent random crash, is just ridiculous, not to mention the bug that keep asking user to re-enter password every time

love the game but get ready to go down a rabbit hole of fixes needed to make this game run on windows 11 without crashing , if it were not for that id say 10/10. if you are looking to actually enjoy playing and not have to deal with this i would highly recommend purchasing on console!

Before I talk about the game itself, I have to say: screw Ubisoft for the state of this game on modern PCs. Ubisoft Connect is easily one of the most frustrating launchers I've ever used. The game constantly crashed on startup, and I had to follow a community guide and apply the Large Address Aware (LAA) patch just to get it running properly. On top of that, Ubisoft Connect kept asking me to enter my password almost every time I launched the game. It's honestly baffling that one of Ubisoft's most iconic titles has such poor compatibility on modern systems.

That said, once I finally got everything working, I had an amazing time. The story is excellent, the gunplay is incredibly satisfying, and Vaas is one of the best-written villains in gaming. The tropical island setting and jungle warfare atmosphere make every encounter exciting, and I genuinely enjoyed every moment of the gameplay (except ubisoft connect)

-There is also times that I couldn't login, it keeps saying "A Ubisoft service is currently unavailable. Please Try again later." The solution that I found is that you have to change your password, in which leads to the first problem that I mentioned.

-Due to the launcher asking me to login everytime I play the game, there are times that it's not syncing properly with steam, thus I'm not able to get achievements, and as a completionist this is insanely annoying. I've tried some workaround and fixes and it does work but most of the time it just goes back to the same issue.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that some achievements are bugged and fail to unlock properly.

citations.review_text: I am rating every single Ubisoft game down due to my hatred of the add on app of Ubisoft Connect for single player games for some reason and annoyance at buggy achievements not unlocking due to Ubisoft Connect server issues.

This is one of my favorite games from my childhood, I'm so nostalgic for it, but I cannot in good conscience recommend you buy it unless its on HEAVY discount. The game has frame rate issues, it crashes constantly, and there's major artificing from some textures. I 100%ed the game in just under 40 hours of play time, but some of the achievements are bugged, like the "Improper Use" achievement that requires you to burn someone with the repair tool taking 30+ seconds to take effect and the "Heartless Pyro" achievement not counting enemies you set on fire with the flame thrower, only the ones who die under the constant flame. While I love this game, there are too many issues and headaches with it for me to comfortably recommend in the year of our lord 2026

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from crashes during cutscenes and gameplay.

citations.review_text:
Game is nice, but overrated. It crashes way too often, especially during cutscenes (and I already did some ”patching” to reduce their number). I had to repeat 15-20 minutes missions 2-3 times because of crashes during cutscenes. Sometimes they happened during the last seconds of the mission's ending cutscene and that can be really frustrating. 

Game-saving is quite disfunctional, sometimes I'm losing progress (collectables not getting registered as collected for example). Furthermore, not having multiple save files feels like an unnecessary risk.

Having to log in to the Ubisoft account every time I play it also feels unnecessary.

P.S. Oh, and the unskipable cutscenes... did I ever tell you the definition of insanity?

This is hands down THE best far cry game out there. The missions and storyline offer a fresh, rewarding perspective on the franchise. 

However, I will say a HUGE downside to this game is the struggles with Ubisoft Connect and game crashes. I hate Ubisoft Connect and it wasted several hours of my time trying to fix it. The game also likes to crash due to its outdated software, which took a bit to fix as well.

Look, I would absolutely get this game, just be prepared to run into a million different operating issues that take forever to resolve.
This Game keeps crashing. I didnt have this issue a year ago when i played. This never happens with any game but this. 5 minutes into gameplay the game crashes. Fix your game Ubisoft.
